claim: On Application Load Balancers and Network Load Balancers, health check settings are defined per target group; each target group uses the default health check settings unless you override them at creation or modify them later.

qualifiers.scope: Application and Network Load Balancer target groups

evidence.quote: You define health check settings for your load balancer on a per target group basis. Each target group uses the default health check settings, unless you override them when you create the target group or modify them later on.
